name: Quotation Generator
title: Quotation Generator Pakistan (Free, PDF)
description: Create a professional quotation with items, discount, optional sales tax, validity date and terms. Free, prints to PDF, nothing is uploaded.
lead: List what you offer, set a validity date and terms, and print a clear quotation for your customer.
intro: A quotation tells a customer what you will supply and at what price before they commit. A clear one avoids disputes about price, delivery and validity.
Fill in the customer and items. Totals, discount and optional tax are worked out for you, and the amount is written in words.
how: Add each item with quantity and rate. The amount is quantity times rate.
Set "Valid until" so the price does not stay open forever.
Put delivery, payment and warranty terms in the terms box.
Leave tax at 0 if your quote is exclusive of tax, or enter the rate to show it.
example: Item A: 10 × Rs. 2,500 = Rs. 25,000. Item B: 4 × Rs. 4,000 = Rs. 16,000. Subtotal Rs. 41,000. With 0% tax the total is Rs. 41,000.
mistakes: Not saying whether prices include or exclude tax.
Leaving out delivery time and payment terms.

faq.q: Is a quotation a legal contract?
faq.a: It is an offer. What binds each side depends on your terms and what the customer accepts. Ask a lawyer for important deals.

faq.q: Should a quotation show sales tax?
faq.a: Many businesses quote exclusive of tax and say so. Others show tax as a line. This tool lets you do either.

faq.q: Can I add my logo and signature?
faq.a: Yes, in "My business profile". They stay in your browser.

disclaimer: This tool only lays out the details you type. It does not file anything with FBR or any authority, and it is not legal or tax advice.
